plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a man named Chris Langan saw UFOs near Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, a base that oversees nuclear missiles. In one retelling, Michels has Langan say he was working for the Forest Service, the US agency that runs national forests, not far from the base at the time. If true, it would add another sighting to a place where others have reported strange objects near nuclear weapons.
